name: Montejícar (Spain)
description: A white triangle from the upper corners to the middle of the lower edge bearing a green eradicated olive tree, the hoist triangle yellow and the fly triangle red.
history: Montejícar adopted its arms and flag officially on 6 March 2007; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of a white triangle with a green eradicated olive tree whose vertices are at the upper corners and the midpoint of the lower edge, the hoist triangle yellow and the fly triangle red.
